speaker: SPEAKER_00

speaker: SPEAKER_00

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: to the housing crisis by forcing interest rates to nearly zero for, it turns out, almost 15 years.

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: subsidized mortgages, along with round after round of QE, money printing, in various flavors.

speaker: SPEAKER_00

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: income inequality that journalists obsess over. It is not dog-eat-dog capitalism, it is the Fed.
